title: Researchers: Oldest Evidence of Lead Pollution Found in Greece
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Ancient Greece produced the earliest records of democracy - and, scientists now say, lead pollution.
sentences.zh: 古希腊创造了最早的民主记录 科学家现在说 铅污染

sentences.en: That is the finding of a study that recently appeared in Communications Earth and Environment .
sentences.zh: 这是最近在通信地球和环境中出现的研究结果。

sentences.en: The researchers studied sediment cores removed from mainland Greece and below the Aegean Sea.
sentences.zh: 研究人员研究了从希腊大陆和爱琴海下移走的沉积物岩芯。

sentences.en: They found in the cores the oldest known evidence of lead pollution in the environment dating back around 5,200 years.
sentences.zh: 他们发现在核心 最古老的已知证据 铅污染 在环境中 大约5200年前。

sentences.en: That is 1,200 years older than the former oldest evidence of lead pollution.
sentences.zh: 这比以前最古老的铅污染证据大了1200年。

sentences.en: That evidence was discovered in Serbia. In ancient times, lead was released into the atmosphere as a product of copper and silver production.
sentences.zh: 这些证据是在塞尔维亚发现的,在古代,铅作为铜和银生产产物释放到大气中。

sentences.en: The toxic, or poisonous, metal turned to dust over time and settled onto the soil.
sentences.zh: 有毒或有毒的金属随着时间推移变成灰尘并沉淀在土壤中。

sentences.en: Joseph Maran of Heidelberg University was a co-writer of the new study.
sentences.zh: 海德堡大学的Joseph Maran是新研究的共同撰稿人。

sentences.en: “Silver was used for jewelry, for special objects — but it wasn't found in a pure state,” it was mined in ore combined with lead, Maran said
sentences.zh: Maran说,“Silver被用于珠宝,用于特殊物品——但并不是在纯状态下发现的,”它用矿石和铅一起开采。

sentences.en: The place with the earliest signs of lead is in northeastern Greece, near the island of Thasos.
sentences.zh: 最早有铅迹象的地方是在希腊东北部,靠近塔索斯岛。

sentences.en: Past evidence suggests Thasos was one of the area’s most important places for silver mining and metalwork, said Maran.
sentences.zh: Maran说,过去的证据显示,塔索斯是该地区最重要的银矿开采和金属工地之一。

sentences.en: Yale historian Joseph Manning, who was not involved in the study, said “Lead released from smelting is the world’s first form of toxic or industrial pollution.”
sentences.zh: 耶鲁历史学家约瑟夫·曼宁(Joseph Manning)没有参与研究,他说,“熔炼释放的线索是世界第一种有毒或工业污染形式。 ”

sentences.en: The researchers found that levels of lead contamination remained fairly low in ancient Greece.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现,古希腊的铅污染水平仍然相当低。

sentences.en: The levels remained low throughout the Bronze Age, the Classical period and the Hellenistic period.
sentences.zh: 青铜时代、古典时期和希腊时期的浓度水平仍然很低。

sentences.en: The Classical period is famous for Athenian democracy, and the thinkers Socrates and Plato.
sentences.zh: 古典时期以雅典民主而闻名 思想家苏格拉底和柏拉图

sentences.en: And the Hellenistic period saw Greek cultural influence reach its height across the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 在希腊时期,希腊文化的影响 达到了地中海的高度。

sentences.en: But the new study shows that around 2,150 years ago “a very strong and abrupt increase" in lead releases caused by human activities took place across Greece, said co-writer Andreas Koutsodendris of Heidelberg University.
sentences.zh: 但新的研究表明,大约2,150年前,由人类活动引起的铅释放“非常强烈和突然增加”,在希腊各地发生。 海德堡大学的Andreas Koutsodondris是联合作者。

sentences.en: Around that time, the Roman army won control of the Greek peninsula, completely changing the area’s society and economy.
sentences.zh: 罗马军队赢得了对希腊半岛的控制,彻底改变了该地区的社会和经济。

sentences.en: As Roman trade, colonies and shipping grew across the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea, demand for silver coins also grew.
sentences.zh: 随着罗马贸易、殖民地和航运在整个地中海和黑海的增长,对银币的需求也增加了。

sentences.en: As a result, more smelting was required, Koutsodendris said.
sentences.zh: Koutsordendris说,因此需要更多的熔炼。

sentences.en: Later the Roman Empire used lead to make tools for eating and building, including pipes.
sentences.zh: 后来罗马帝国用铅制造食物和建筑工具,包括管道。

sentences.en: Past research – including a study of ice cores from Greenland – had detected high levels of lead across much of the Northern Hemisphere during Roman times.
sentences.zh: 过去的研究,包括对格陵兰冰芯的研究,在罗马时代发现北半球大部分地区的铅含量很高。

sentences.en: But the new study adds a more exact “and local picture to how lead levels changed,” said Nathan Chellman.
sentences.zh: 内森·切尔曼(Nathan Chellman)指出,

sentences.en: Chellman, an environmental scientist at the University of Nevada, Reno, was not involved in the research.
sentences.zh: Chellman是内华达大学(里诺)的一名环境科学家,没有参与研究。

sentences.en: I'm John Russell. Christina Larson reported on this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·罗素 克里斯蒂娜·拉尔森为美联社报道了这个故事

sentences.en: John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: John Russell改编了它 用于VOA学习英语。
